e.note: Best: A1 at 14.2% reach vs 7.9% for the benchmark

e.text: A1 leads at 14.2% versus the 7.9% benchmark; asking the Critic how to push further.

e.note: Reading results for A1, A2, A3

critique.summary: A1 is the clear leader at 14.2% reach (10th percentile 12.7%) for $879 per point, against the benchmark's 7.9% at $1611, because early café seeding plus full-length city social builds the strongest word of mouth (51.8%). Street teams and late or short social windows are underperforming, and the $2500 launch-day pop-ups earn little because they land on day 41, too late to spread.

findings.finding: Best on every measure: 14.2% reach, 10th percentile 12.7% (above A2/A3's 90th-percentile-adjacent means), $879 per point, with social at 25.9% for $7560 and Doctores cafés each returning 1.3–2.0% for $300.
Weakest partners are Forest Cafe (0.7%), Kaffeina in Atlampa (0.7%) and Café 144 in Miguel Hidalgo (0.6%), each still about $430–500 per point, cheaper than the benchmark's $1611.

12.1% reach at $1142 per point. The Fjällräven collab earns 5.7% for $2000, but eight street teams ($3600) return only 0.4–0.9% each, and cutting social to 30 days leaves it at 22.3% versus A1's 25.9%.

Podcasts pull their weight (10.7% for $3500, 9.2% for $3450), but social starting day 25 returns only 11.8%, and the day-41 Chomp Chomp pop-up returns 1.8% for $2500, the worst cost per point in the plan.
7.9% reach (6.8–9.0%) at $1611 per point. Its street teams return 1.0–1.7% for $450, so all three plans beat it, A1 by 1.8x.

changes.change: Keep A1's day-0 café seeding and 42-day city social, but replace the day-41 Boicot pop-up ($2500) with the Fjällräven collab from day 10 ($2000).
changes.why: The collab earned 5.7% in A2, while a launch-eve pop-up has no time for word of mouth to spread (A3's pop-up returned 1.8% for $2500).

changes.change: Drop Café 144 (Miguel Hidalgo) and Kaffeina (Colonia Atlampa) from A1, and add more Colonia Doctores partners like Chomp Chomp and Kerbels.
changes.why: Doctores partners return 1.3–2.0% each, versus 0.6–0.7% for the dropped two.

changes.change: Use the ~$2540 of remaining budget for the Armchair Expert host-read on day 5 ($3500, trimming elsewhere if needed) rather than street teams.
changes.why: The podcast returned 10.7% in A3, while street teams in zones 0–3 returned only 0.4–0.9% for $450 each.
It has only 0.293 mean fit and 1.1% of the natural audience.

e.note: Writing the launch plan for B2

plan.headline: Media-led early burst reaches 18.5% of the natural audience, 2.3× benchmark
plan.summary: The bet is to front-load city social ads, two over-indexing podcasts and a Fjällräven co-branded drop in the first two weeks, so word of mouth has the longest possible runway, with six Colonia Doctores-area cafés seeding locally throughout. Qloo taste data shows this audience over-indexes strongly on Fjällräven (0.94), Armchair Expert (0.92) and Absolutely Not (0.90), and the partner cafés score 0.74–0.87 affinity through Warby Parker, Patagonia and Outdoor Voices fans. In simulation the plan reaches 18.5% of the natural audience (16.4%–20.5% range) versus 7.9% for the benchmark, at $777 per point of reach against $1,611, with word of mouth driving 58.8% of adoption; this is a projection from a simulation built on Qloo taste data, not a guarantee.

weeks.label: 6–5 weeks before launch
items: 42 days before launch: sign all six café partners, deliver flyers and counter cards; finalize podcast scripts and Fjällräven drop terms.
41 days before launch: start 20 days of targeted city social ads, weighted toward best-fit areas.
39 days before launch: host-read ad airs on Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard.
36 days before launch: announce and open the co-branded Fjällräven drop, running to launch day.
33 days before launch: host-read ad airs on Absolutely Not.

weeks.label: 4–3 weeks before launch
items: 28 days before launch: refresh café flyers and check card stock at all six partners.
22 days before launch: city social ads finish; shift effort to café seeding and Fjällräven drop content.
21 days before launch: review weekly metrics and restock the strongest cafés (Chomp Chomp, Boicot) first.

weeks.label: 2–1 weeks before launch
items: 14 days before launch: push Fjällräven drop reminders through café partners and existing social channels.
7 days before launch: final flyer round at all cafés with opening-day details for Roma Norte.

weeks.label: Launch week
items: Launch day: open the Roma Norte pop-up with the Fjällräven drop on display; track café-flyer and podcast-referral visitors.

risks: Projections come from a simulation built on Qloo taste data; real reach may fall outside the 16.4%–20.5% range.
Front-loaded spend ends 22 days before launch; awareness may fade if word of mouth (58.8% of adoption) underperforms.
Forest Cafe, Brown Caffeine Lab and El Martigon earn little simulated credit; distance keeps far-off districts like Iztapalapa out.
Podcasts are US shows; actual Mexico City listenership may differ from modeled affinity.
measure: Weekly share of pop-up interest traced to social, each podcast, Fjällräven and each café (codes or flyer redemptions).
